question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**dodging**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The title of the given passage is 'Traffic Congestion'.
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**dodging**'.
 
• ‘**Dodging**’ means to move quickly in order to avoid somebody/something.
 
• The given passage talks about the everyday struggle of dodging traffic. 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**Correct Passage:**__ *For an average Indian, driving in any of the major Indian cities is equivalent to waging a daily war. The everyday struggle of **dodging** traffic, pollution and rash drivers is (3) ______ biggest cause of chronic stress and other (4) ______ problems. On an average a person spends (5) ______ between thirty minutes to two hours of their day driving.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__***

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words in the other options.
 
• Lodging - A temporary residence 
 
• Boarding - The act getting into a ship, train, airplane, or the like.
 
• Stopping - To cease moving
